blocks.text: HANGS Company Card and Expense Policy
HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented policy for a software demonstration.

Each monthly statement is coded in full: every charge and credit is credited to 2050 Company Card Payable and debited where it belongs. A charge that needs a decision is held in 1990 Card Charges Pending Review, never left uncoded.

An itemized receipt is required for every charge of $75.00 or more, attached within 30 days of the statement date. Without one, the cardholder signs a missing-receipt affidavit the Controller approves, or the charge is treated as personal.
The card is for HANGS business only. A personal charge is coded to 1910 Due From Employees and repaid by the cardholder within 30 days, by check or, with written consent, by payroll deduction.

Two charges with the same merchant, date and amount and only one receipt are a duplicate. The second is disputed with the card issuer within 60 days of the statement date and held in 1920 Card Disputes Receivable until credited.

A subscription or renewal may be charged only when the Approved Subscriptions Register shows it approved. Any other renewal is held in 1990 until the Controller approves it or it is cancelled for a refund.
Code each charge by what was bought, using the coding guide in Appendix A. Materials for a job go to 1400 with the job and cost code on the receipt.

When a seller outside Washington ships goods to HANGS without charging Washington sales tax, accrue use tax at the delivery location's rate, 9.6% for Anytown, to 2150 Use Tax Payable, and report it on the monthly excise return.
Business miles in a personal vehicle are reimbursed at $0.70 a mile from a mileage log on the expense report, credited to 2060 Employee Reimbursements Payable and paid with the next expense check.
The Controller reviews the coded statement, every proposed entry and every reimbursement request. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.
Appendix A. Coding Guide by Merchant Category

rows: Job materials: the job and cost code on the receipt (JOB-1); 6200 when no job is named
Tools and supplies; a single item of $5,000 or more is a fixed asset (CAP-1)
Job rentals take the job; yard rentals none
Only subscriptions approved in the register (CARD-5)
